# Introduction

The **`decisioncompare`** analysis (Compare Medical Decision Tests) provides clinicopathological researchers and biostatisticians with intuitive, publication-ready tools in jamovi and R.

## Key Capabilities

- Function for comparing multiple Medical Decision Tests. Compares sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, negative predictive value, and other metrics between different tests against the same gold standard. Includes statistical comparison using McNemar's test and confidence intervals for differences.
- Seamless integration between jamovi graphical interface and automated R syntax generation.
- Rigorous handling of missing data, small cohorts, and multi-variable stratification.

# Example Workflow in R

```r
library(ClinicoPathJamoviModule)

# Load package test dataset
data("decisioncompare_test_data", package = "ClinicoPathJamoviModule", envir = environment())

# Run analysis with default settings
# ClinicoPathJamoviModule::decisioncompare(
#   data = decisioncompare_test_data
# )
```

# Clinical & Statistical Interpretation

Outputs generated by `decisioncompare` include summary tables, diagnostic indicators, and high-resolution plots tailored for oncology, pathology, and clinical trial reporting.
